title: "2) API links (endpoints)"
lang: en

::: {.callout-note}
## Start here
Second part of the **heart of the repository**: here are the **API links (endpoints)**
you paste into `.env`. The code ships with `INSIRA_AQUI` — you replace it with the
values below.
:::

`.env` has **four** endpoints. Each serves a different step:

| Variable in `.env` | Official endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CDSE_TOKEN_URL` | `https://identity.dataspace.copernicus.eu/auth/realms/CDSE/protocol/openid-connect/token` | get the access token |
| `CDSE_STATS_URL` | `https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/api/v1/statistics` | **Statistical API** (series) |
| `CDSE_CATALOG_URL` | `https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products` | OData catalog (list granules) |
| `CDSE_DOWNLOAD_URL` | `https://download.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products` | product download (L2) |

## Copy into `.env`

```bash
CDSE_TOKEN_URL=https://identity.dataspace.copernicus.eu/auth/realms/CDSE/protocol/openid-connect/token
CDSE_STATS_URL=https://sh.dataspace.copernicus.eu/api/v1/statistics
CDSE_CATALOG_URL=https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products
CDSE_DOWNLOAD_URL=https://download.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products
```

::: {.callout-tip}
These are **public** API addresses (not secrets). They are not pre-filled in the code
(`INSIRA_AQUI`) so you declare your own configuration in `.env`.
:::

## Where to confirm (official docs)

- **CDSE documentation:** <https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu>
  - OData (catalog and download): <https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/OData.html>
  - Sentinel Hub (Statistical API): <https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/SentinelHub.html>
- **Sentinel Hub — Statistical API:** <https://docs.sentinel-hub.com/api/latest/api/statistical/>

## How to test each piece

### 1) Token (OAuth client)

::: {.lang-python}
```python
from tropomi_ch4.config import get_credentials, endpoints
import requests

creds = get_credentials()
r = requests.post(endpoints()["token"], data={
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "client_id": creds.client_id,
    "client_secret": creds.client_secret,
}, timeout=60)
print(r.status_code)                 # 200 = ok
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
source("r/tropomi_ch4.R")
tok <- cdse_token()
cat(substr(tok, 1, 20), "...\n")
```
:::

### 2) Statistical API (series)

::: {.lang-python}
```python
import tropomi_ch4 as tch4
df = tch4.monthly(start="2022-01-01", end="2022-03-01")
print(df.head())
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
source("r/tropomi_ch4.R")
df <- ch4_mensal("2022-01-01", "2022-03-01")
head(df)
```
:::

### 3) OData catalog (L2)

::: {.lang-python}
```python
from tropomi_ch4 import l2
print(len(l2.list_granules(2022, 1)), "granules in 2022-01")
```
:::

::: {.lang-r}
```r
source("r/mapas_l2.R")
cat(length(l2_granules(2022, 1)), "granules in 2022-01\n")
```
:::
